targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensors" and r["sensor_type"] == "temperature" and exists r["tenant_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == v.tenant)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensors" and r["sensor_type"] == "humidity" and exists r["tenant_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == v.tenant)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "sensors" and r["sensor_type"] == "dewpoint" and exists r["tenant_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["tenant_id"] == v.tenant)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket:"sensors")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r["tenant_id"] and r["_field"] == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["tenant_id", "sensor_type"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "tenant_id", "sensor_type", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "value", _time: "time"})

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -90d)
  |> keep(columns: ["tenant_id"])
  |> distinct(column: "tenant_id")
  |> sort()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.tenant_id}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
